Title: Use 'SAS', R, and 'quarto' Together
Description:
Use R and 'SAS' within reproducible multilingual 'quarto'
documents. Run 'SAS' code blocks interactively, send data back
and forth between 'SAS' and R, and render 'SAS' output within
'quarto' documents. 'SAS' connections are established through a
combination of 'SASPy' and 'reticulate'.
SystemRequirements:
python (>= 3.4.0), SASPy, java (>= 7) required for
IOM access method

cmake make default-jdk libpng-dev libuv1-dev
python3
